name: Estival-Fathom
description: Everything on this world is mid-formation: cones rising, calderas collapsing, new land cooling to black glass. The terrain gathers itself around crystal cavern networks, and by night the whole horizon pulses like a banked furnace.
Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
